usageNotes: Returns the top-level resource directory index for the Proxmox Datacenter Manager API. Use this as a discovery call to enumerate available API resource categories — useful for probing what the connected PDM instance exposes before making targeted requests. No parameters are required and all authenticated users have access.

examples.summary: List all top-level PDM API resources

tips: This is a pure discovery endpoint — the response is the API directory index, not operational data about managed nodes or VMs.
Because permissions are 'user: all', any valid API token can call this regardless of role.
